status: Independent conditional design matrix; no government/UN/OSCE/IAEA endorsement or live monitoring

trackDefinitions.title: Track 1 — Kinetic de-escalation & nuclear/civilian security
trackDefinitions.scope: Mutual restraint, protected-person obligations, policy-level arms separation and qualified incident review. No tactical deployment data.
trackDefinitions.nondelegable: No research tool can impose ceasefires, compel access, or task an international organization without its authorization.

trackDefinitions.title: Track 2 — Governance, law & rights
trackDefinitions.scope: Territorial integrity, lawful interim governance, voluntary participation, displaced-person rights, minority/language protections, and constitutionally lawful institutions.
decisionOwners: other formally empowered parties when required
relevant international body within a valid mandate
trackDefinitions.nondelegable: A five-year wait does not legalize occupied-territory plebiscites, and the UN does not assume administration automatically.

trackDefinitions.title: Track 3 — Economic & ecological recovery
trackDefinitions.scope: Lawful finance, open contracting, grid resilience, human-supervised mine action, civilian shipping and community-led ecological restoration.
trackDefinitions.nondelegable: Assets, power transfers and safety certification depend on legal authority and independently verifiable operating capacity.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Documented humanitarian restraint & verifiable ceasefire options
phases.objective: Generate limited, testable protection arrangements with evidenced consent and a credible incident dispute mechanism.
entryConditions: Separate identification of Ukrainian/Russian empowered counterparts for bilateral restraints
Written scope, protected-person safety, IHL review
Identified verifier and access/communications mandate, not presumed
exitCriteria: Independent record of time-bound observed compliance with publicly defined caveats
Contested incidents classified and adjudication route tested
No unsupported claim of enforceable peace
phases.fallback: Maintain lawful unilateral civilian protection, ICRC-compatible engagement, evidence collection and non-escalatory repair coordination.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Lawful governance alternatives & contested-status safeguards
phases.objective: Review lawful temporary arrangements, services and rights without prejudicing Ukraine’s internationally recognized borders.
entryConditions: Mandate competence and explicit international institutional acceptance
exitCriteria: Human-rights protections have named competent implementers and remedy channels
Any status mechanism passes an independent legality test before further design
phases.fallback: Use locally lawful public services, language protections and verified voluntary return programmes without administering occupied territory or proposing premature ballots.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Accountable regenerative reconstruction
phases.objective: Fund, govern, evaluate and maintain safe civilian recovery with independently verified public value.
entryConditions: Local consent, land tenure, environment and procurement due diligence
Accredited technical implementers and independent auditing
exitCriteria: Audited public service delivery and measured availability
Certified land release and independent safety inspection
Published, privacy-safe ecological outcomes and maintenance plans
phases.fallback: Defer unsafe projects, maintain humanitarian assistance, publish audit exceptions and redirect to legally available lower-risk alternatives.

pathways.title: Verified cessation-of-hostilities option
pathways.hypothesis: Develop a conditional, civilian-protection-centred monitoring and incident-resolution framework; no automatic enforcement.
mechanisms: Negotiate public definitions of covered conduct and synchronized effective time.
Approve monitoring scope and safeguards; review telemetry handling at an aggregate level.
Run a synthetic incident-dispute exercise before any live claims.

riskMitigations.mitigation: Alternative agreed civilian-access monitoring or defer verification label
Protect granular sensor data; publish only delayed aggregated results

Trial only simulated or non-sensitive sensor data with quantified false alarms.
Determine admissibility and contestability of evidence.
